acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing.
alkylation_concentration: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups
alkylation_reagent: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups
cleavage_agent: Five microliters of Lys-C (0.25 ng in 50 mM ABC) was added and incubated at 37°C for 4 h. Five microliters of trypsin (0.25 ng in 50 mM ABC) was added and incubated overnight at 37°C.
collision_energy: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
fragmentation_method: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
instrument: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ionization_type: Electrospray voltage of 1.9 kV was applied at the source.
labeling: LFQ calculations were performed separately in each parameter group containing similar cell loading.
mass_analyzer: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ptm: carbamidomethylation, N-terminal protein acetylation, methionine oxidation
N-terminal protein acetylation and methionine oxidation were selected as variable modifications. Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification.
reduction_concentration: For LCM tissue samples, 100 nL of RapiGest solution (0.1% in 50 mM ABC) containing 5 mM DTT was added.
reduction_reagent: Cells were lysed at a concentration of 5 ×–105/mL in 0.1% RapiGest and 5 mM DTT in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (ABC).
